item.title: Registration Opens Monday For Escambia Sheriff’s Office Citizens’ Firearm Class
item.description: Registration opens Monday, January 12 for the next Escambia County Sheriff’s Office Citizens’ Firearm Class. The class will start on February 28. The registration link will be posted on the ECSO Facebook page on Monday. Class space is limited.
